name: Tungsten diselenide
equilibrium_context: Semiconductor, indirect gap about 1.2 eV, direct gap at the K point about 1.6 eV; inversion breaking in the monolayer produces Berry curvature at K and K'

driven_states.emergent_property: Floquet-Bloch sidebands at the valence band near K. No gap resolved: the expected Rabi gap of 100 to 200 meV was NOT observed. The core statement is the destruction of Floquet states by scattering as soon as electronic excitations are present.
driven_states.source: Aeschlimann et al., Nano Letters 21, 5028 (2021), doi:10.1021/acs.nanolett.1c00801
driven_states.caveat: A null result for the gap, not a demonstration of a gap. The energy resolution of 150 meV is of the same order of magnitude as the expected gap, so the non-observation is only partly conclusive. The explanation via decoherence rests on a two-level model and TDDFT, not on a direct measurement of the scattering time. The Volkov distinction, by contrast, is clean: for s polarization the field lies in the plane, and the first-order Volkov contribution is exactly zero.

threshold.quantity: none - Floquet dressing has no threshold

further_sources: Fragkos et al., Nat. Commun. 16, 5799 (2025), doi:10.1038/s41467-025-61076-7 (independent group)

driven_states.emergent_property: Strongly valley-polarized Floquet-Bloch states: the first-order sideband is markedly stronger at the K or K' valley for right- or left-circular driving polarization respectively, and the valley asymmetry is fully reversible via the helicity. The cause is valley-dependent quantum path interference between the Floquet and the Volkov channel.
driven_states.caveat: The weakest Volkov exclusion in the whole Floquet area. The authors state openly that pure Volkov simulations already reproduce most of the measured angular distributions and that only a residual feature forces the Floquet channel. The valley asymmetry is itself an interference quantity, not a pure Floquet observable. No gap and no band renormalization measured. An incidence angle of 65 degrees means a maximal Volkov contribution.

threshold.quantity: none - Floquet dressing has no threshold

driven_states.measured_quantity: momentum-resolved photoemission, sideband asymmetry between K and K'

sources: Aeschlimann et al., Nano Letters 21, 5028 (2021), doi:10.1021/acs.nanolett.1c00801
gaps: Both entries measure sideband intensities, not band renormalization - the weaker class of observation.
